title: Refactoring my portfolio in 2026
excerpt: After nearly a year, I have decided to come back to finish what I started.
body: A portfolio is a developers business card. And imagine that you receive a business card that is stained with food and all wrinkly. It still does the job, it has your number on it but... does not really leave a good impression, from now in, I will take my portfolio and personal projects serious again

title: Starting my own Unity videogame
excerpt: I am starting an ongoing Unity videogame project to build stronger game development, interaction design, and production skills.
body:
I am starting my own Unity videogame as an ongoing project. The goal is to move beyond prototypes and build something with a clearer loop, better player feedback, and a more polished feel.

This project is still in progress, so I am treating it as a place to practise gameplay systems, scene design, input handling, and the small details that make a game feel responsive.

title: Starting SudoHub, my career connection SaaS
excerpt: I am building SudoHub, an ongoing SaaS idea focused on helping people make better career connections.
body:
I am starting SudoHub, a SaaS project for career connection. The idea is to create a practical space where people can discover opportunities, present themselves clearly, and connect with others around professional growth.

This is still an ongoing project, so I am shaping the product around the core workflows first: profiles, discovery, connection intent, and a simple experience that makes career networking feel more useful.
